notes:
- **With a graphics card, the speaker model that tells people apart during a call runs on the card.** The live fingerprints are the same numbers as before, made on your card instead of your processor, so the processor is left to the call and your other apps. If the card isn't available or its answers differ from the processor's, A9 Voice uses the processor and nothing else changes. See [Speakers on this PC](/docs/speakers-on-this-pc/#on-your-graphics-card).
- **The install video now shows the Microsoft Store.** [Install A9 Voice from the Microsoft Store](/docs/getting-started/#install) (under 1 minute) goes from a9voice.com's Store badge to your first dictation, with no Windows warning on the way. It sits in the first step of Getting started; the steps for a work PC that blocks the Store stay as text.
- **The live transcript keeps the conversation in order.** When you speak again after others, your words start a new line instead of joining your earlier one. A line also ends at a long pause, so a quiet stretch no longer ties two things you said minutes apart into one.
